experiment_source: the lead claims the E-number and sets it here before the run; run.py refuses stage0 and items until it reads E<digits>
amends: experiments/adl/results/predictions.json (run 1, E264, cluster job 63409), which stays as filed and ran
descriptive: a scorecard column (the user asked for the baseline); no reuse/new verdict under either wording of the definition
filed: 2026-11-22, after run 1's stage 0 and before any run of this amendment
change: the positive control only: E53's lowercase_s0 (as the pair list builds it, the reuse side of e53_lowercase_cipher at c = 1, its saved update) replaces E237's copy_s0, and its random update is that pair side's random (e53_lowercase_cipher/random_reuse, finetune.random_direction of lowercase_s0 at seed 259006). Settings, the scalar D, the bars (inert 0.05, above the 64-direction max, above random + 3 sd) and the 129 items are run 1's, unchanged. If the control passes, the items run as filed, written under results/amend1/.
why: run 1's control was mismatched to the lens: copy_s0 is a key-dependent change (each key maps to its own answer), and a mean over unrelated text cancels any change that is not one constant direction, which run 1's plan listed as a blind spot of D. It read D 0.0028 against a 64-direction max of 0.0048, with no answer token in the logit lens top 20 (reports/analyses/2026-11-22_analysis_e264-adl-stage0.md). Lowercasing is the same shift on every text (toward lowercase forms), the narrow constant-direction case the paper's organisms are; a constant vector already recovers 0.71 of its gain on the scorecard (E143's fair steering, pooled, experiments/holes_fill/results/stage1.json .states["e53/lowercase_s0"].steering.pooled.share).

settings.settings_source: run 1's filed settings, unchanged but the two control keys (experiments/adl/results/predictions.json)
settings.control_source: the item list's names: E187's e53_lowercase_cipher pair, reuse side (the smaller side, c = 1), state e53/lowercase_s0 and that side's random update

thresholds.thresholds_e143_source: run 1's: E143's filed gain_floor, inert and zero_tol (experiments/holes_fill/results/predictions.json)

repeat_gain.source_detail: experiments/holes_fill/results/stage1.json .states["e53/lowercase_s0"].gain: E143's Job.state gain, mean of holes_fill lo_at(dW) minus W0's on E136's read rows of e53/lowercase, the saved update unscaled, fp32 with TF32 off; run.py's gain() is the same lo_at on the same inventory (E187's pairs(), built from E136's), so the same path at the same size (c = 1). Bar: E147's reader_neuron_tol 1e-4, as run 1

stage0.order: first and alone; items refuse unless results/amend1/stage0.json says passed
stage0.do_nothing: as run 1: E237's do-nothing (copy_s0 times 0, a zero change), read now on the control's task rows: max |delta_bar| <= zero_tol, every removed log-odds and the gain within zero_tol of 0; D nan
stage0.repeat: the control's gain equals E143's 1.67213 within 1e-4
stage0.stop_rule: as run 1: passed iff the do-nothing and the repeat hold AND D(control) >= 0.05 AND D(control) > the largest share of the 64 random-difference directions on the control AND D(control) >= D(control random) + 3 sd of those 64 shares. Otherwise stop; the cell closes with both controls failed (the lead decides).

control.lens_relevance_max: >= 0.10 (two of the top 20 are answer tokens at some position; the task has 296 distinct answer tokens on its 500 read rows, measured on CPU 2026-11-22, so chance is 0.12 tokens of 20 and a best rank near 169); best answer rank < 169
control.confidence: medium: a constant vector recovers 0.71 of this gain at the answer position (E143), but D reverts only one direction at block 2 found on positions 0-4 of other text, and the gain is small (1.67, near the floor of 1), so the 64-direction spread over it is larger than run 1's

control_random_update.D: |D| < 0.02 (its gain is about 0; over G = 1.67 rather than run 1's 16.45 the same noise reads about ten times larger)
